description: Checkpoint loading (design 3.2, 3.3 precision rules) and branch orchestration over the cascade levels in both modes (design 3.4, 4.4, 4.5): inference/loader.py (LoadedModel, unchunked group-size bound) and inference/runner.py (BRANCHES, StreamedRunner, UnchunkedRunner, per-chunk sink at level 1). Tests: cascade streamed == unchunked (AC 1) and trainer equivalence of the internal fields / A (AC 2, level 2 and level 1 internal part), loader tests. Depends on FEAT-002. The NIfTI / canonical output side is FEAT-004.
steps: Create inference/loader.py: load_model(checkpoint_path, branches, precision='checkpoint', device='gpu') -> LoadedModel (a small class or namedtuple: level, model, frozen (None | cascade.FrozenStage | cascade.FrozenChain), model_cfg, knobs, step, prefix, run_dir, config (dict), training_group_sizes {group_size, deform_group_size}, precision record). Steps exactly design 3.2: runtime.checkpoint.resolve_checkpoint -> source_config_path (None -> LoaderError 'no config.json next to the checkpoint'); ModelConfig.from_dict(config['model_config']); args = config['args']; knobs with defaults for absent keys (amp False, split_group_conv False, deform_decoder_dtype 'policy', fp16_act_clip 0.0, fp16_act_clip_scope 'deform_decoder', bn_epsilon_override 0.0, lowres_method recorded only); deform requested and not model_cfg.deform_decoder -> LoaderError; trainable model built under mixed_float16 iff amp and precision == 'checkpoint' and device == 'gpu' (device cpu on an AMP checkpoint -> WARNING, precision.trainable 'float32 (cpu)'), else float32, via models.precision.policy_scope, GroupRegLevelModel(level, cfg, gradient_checkpointing='none', lean_sampler=True, split_group_conv=..., fp16_act_clip=..., fp16_act_clip_scope=..., deform_decoder_dtype=mapped, bn_epsilon_override=...).build_model(1); 'float16' under a float32 build -> 'policy' with INFO and record {'checkpoint': 'float16', 'used': 'policy (float32 build)'}; knobs.lean_sampler = {'checkpoint': value, 'used': True}. Frozen: level 2 -> FrozenStage.from_config(cfg); level 1 -> FrozenChain.from_config(cfg). Restore tf.train.Checkpoint(model=m, **extra) with extra {} / {'frozen_stage': ...} / {'frozen_stage_4': ..., 'frozen_stage_2': ...}; expect_partial(); assert_existing_objects_matched(); failures -> LoaderError with the TF message. Fingerprints: level 2 config['cascade']['fingerprint'] vs FrozenStage.fingerprint; level 1 every config['cascade']['stages'][k] vs frozen.fingerprints[level] (runtime.checkpoint.fingerprints_match with its default rtol 1e-12, which equals main.FINGERPRINT_RTOL; do not import main). Step = tf.train.load_variable(prefix, runtime.checkpoint.STEP_KEY). LoaderError is a ValueError subclass the CLI maps to exit 2.

In inference/loader.py add unchunked_n_max(level, model_cfg, tasks, split_group_conv, frozen_levels) = min over the tasks and over all cascade stages (frozen stages: their own level, split False) of floor((2**31 - 1) / E_max) using streaming.max_elements_per_image, plus check_unchunked(n, ...) raising LoaderError 'unchunked mode at level L supports at most n_max subjects (largest tensor <name>, E_max elements per image); use --mode streamed or fewer --n-subjects'. Computable from the config alone (no model build).

Create inference/runner.py: BRANCHES = {'rigid': ('rigid', None), 'affine': ('affine', None), 'deform': (None, 'deform'), 'affine+deform': ('affine', 'deform')}. Common interface run(images, branches, sink) where images is float32 numpy [N, 160, 224, 192] (level-1 grid), sink(i0, i1, res) receives per chunk at level 1: res = {'A': [k, 4, 4] float32 tensor or None, 'U1': level-1 field or None, 'U1_inv': ..., 'u_ckpt', 'u_inv_ckpt' (the fields at the checkpoint level after compose_cascade, before upsampling; for test (b))}; returns a summary dict (A for all N as numpy, chunks per level and pass, capped, stats (max |v| per level), fp16_max_abs, timing_s per level stage, gpu_peak_mb per phase via tf.config.experimental.reset_memory_stats / get_memory_info('GPU:0') when a GPU is used).

StreamedRunner(loaded, store, chunks={'l1':2,'l2':8,'l4':32}, lean=True): level inputs are derived per chunk from the level-1 source (raw images, or for affine+deform the store 'src_affine' = layers.transform_image(I, tfm.affine_inverse(A), 1.0) computed per chunk at level 1 and freed after the level-1 P0): x2 = cascade.pool_to_coarser(x1), x4 = pool(x2). Linear task t (design 4.4): level 4 StreamedLevel(model4).linear -> A4 = model4.centering(A_raw4) (single-stage) ; level 2 x2' = cascade.prewarp_linear(x2, A4, P.LEVEL_SPACING[2]) per chunk -> A2 = cascade.compose_linear(A_raw2, A4, model2.centering); level 1 x1' = prewarp_linear(x1, A2, 1) -> A = compose_linear(A_raw1, A2, model1.centering). For a level-2 checkpoint only the first two steps (model2 = trainable), level 4: A = model.centering(A_raw). Deform: level 4 StreamedLevel(model4).deform on x4 (fields stored at level 4); level 2 prev_fn = upsample_displacement of the stored level-4 u / u_inv per chunk and input_fn = diffeo.warp(cast(x2, float32), U4, lean=lean) (the body of cascade.prewarp_deform with the lean flag); then level 1 likewise with the stored level-2 composed fields; at the checkpoint level pass sink-wrapping that upsamples (repeated diffeo.upsample_displacement) to level 1 for level-2/4 checkpoints. Frozen-stage models are run by StreamedLevel too (float32). Free every store as soon as it is consumed.

UnchunkedRunner(loaded): the same orchestration with each level stage as ONE tf.function call on all N (tensors on the device, one trace per input shape, input signature like Trainer._cascade_val_fn): linear chain.linear_stages / stage.linear, CS.prewarp_linear, model(x_in, task=t, training=False)['A_raw'], CS.compose_linear; deform chain.deform / stage.deform, CS.prewarp_deform, model(x_in, 'deform', training=False), diffeo.compose_cascade (= Trainer._cascade_val_deform_fn without the baseline extras). Calls loader.check_unchunked first. Then sink(0, N, res).

Create tests/predict_helpers.py (TF test helper, imports tests.tf_setup first): save_level4_run(root, name, cfg, seed, amp=False, extra_args=None), save_cascade_run(root, name, m2, frozen_stage, args) and save_chain_run(root, name, m1, chain, args): write runtime.logging.make_run_dir paths, a RunCheckpoint(paths['ckpt_last'], paths['ckpt_best'], model, opt, tf.Variable(step, tf.int64), extra=frozen.checkpoint_extra()).save_last(), and runtime.checkpoint.write_config(paths['config'], cfg, args, extra={'cascade': {...fingerprint..., 'stages': [...] for level 1}}) with the same record keys main.py writes (main.py 322-354). Return the checkpoint prefix.

Create tests/test_predict_runner.py (TF): (a) cascade streamed vs unchunked with TINY randomised stages (tests.test_cascade CascadeTrainerCase.stages-style construction / ChainCase.frozen_models), level-2 checkpoint (FrozenStage + trainable level-2) and level-4 single stage: branches rigid, affine, deform, affine+deform; chunks 1, 2, N (N 3); float32 (S_stream: fields 1e-4 vox, A 1e-5) and mixed_float16 trainable stage (S_fp16); assert the chunk boundaries recorded per level ([(0, 2), (2, 3)] at chunk 2). Level 1 (TestStreamingLevel1): FrozenChain from ChainCase.frozen_models + a trainable level-1 copy built under FLOAT32 (not ChainCase.level1_model, which is AMP), split_group_conv True, N 3, chunks 1 and 2, branches deform and affine+deform, everything (models, chain, runner) inside `with tf.device('/CPU:0'):`; print runtime and peak RSS (resource.getrusage). (b) trainer equivalence: level 2 with a cascade Trainer (CascadeTrainerCase.make-style, cfg n_classes=N_CLASSES) and level 1 with a Trainer + FrozenChain (ChainCase.make1-style but amp=False, float32 level-1 model, chain_config(amp=False, val_pair_chunk=1, n_classes=N_CLASSES)), under the CPU scope at level 1: UnchunkedRunner internal u_ckpt / u_inv_ckpt and A vs Trainer._val_deform_fn(N)(x) / Trainer._val_fn(task, N)(x)['A'] under tests.test_trainer._OpDeterminism with TF_CUDNN_USE_AUTOTUNE=0 (set by the runner script): S_exact (fields / A <= 1e-6; fallback 1e-5 with the measured max printed, as design AC 0); Dice via Trainer._deform_errors(labels, u, u_inv, v, v_raw, seed=0) on both sides identical (fallback |diff| <= 1e-6); trainer warp diffeo.warp(x, u_trainer) vs the runner's internal warp at that level <= 1e-5. Streamed chunk 1 and chunk N: the same quantities within S_stream. Inputs: synthetic level-2 / level-1 groups (runtime.fixed_data.synthetic_deform_group and tests.runtime_helpers.synthetic_group) made full-res by np.repeat x2 per axis for level-2 checkpoints so pooling returns them exactly.

Create tests/test_predict_loader.py (TF): save_level4_run with amp True and args deform_decoder_dtype 'float16' loads with precision 'float32' (no exception, d-stage policies float32, record {'checkpoint': 'float16', 'used': 'policy (float32 build)'}, every restored variable equals the saved one) and with precision 'checkpoint' builds float16 decoder stages; an old-style config (args without deform_decoder_dtype / fp16_act_clip / bn_epsilon_override keys) loads with defaults; a level-2 run whose cascade.fingerprint is altered -> LoaderError naming the level; missing config.json -> LoaderError; deform requested on a model without deform_decoder -> LoaderError; unchunked_n_max for a default-width level-1 config (built from ModelConfig() with deform_decoder=True, no model) = 4 for deform and 9 for linear, and check_unchunked(5, ...) raises with the n_max message.
py3.8 ast check of the new files; commit locally on main ('predict-script FEAT-003: checkpoint loader, streamed / unchunked cascade runners'). Never push.
acceptance_criteria: tests.test_predict_runner passes: streamed == unchunked within S_stream / S_fp16 at levels 4 and 2 for all four branch values and chunks 1, 2, N; level 1 on the CPU for deform and affine+deform; maxima printed
tests.test_predict_runner trainer-equivalence tests pass at level 2 and level 1 within S_exact (unchunked) and S_stream (streamed), Dice identical; maxima printed
tests.test_predict_loader passes (precision mapping, absent keys, fingerprint mismatch, missing config, unchunked bound 4 / 9)
tests.test_cascade still passes (helpers imported from it are unchanged)
verification: tf_gpu: python -m unittest tests.test_predict_runner -v -> OK (print the measured maxima and the level-1 peak RSS)
tf_gpu: python -m unittest tests.test_predict_streaming -v -> still OK
bgr_preproc38: ast feature_version=(3, 8) on inference/*.py tests/predict_helpers.py tests/test_predict_runner.py tests/test_predict_loader.py
findings: FILES: inference/loader.py, inference/runner.py (new), inference/__init__.py (docstring), tests/predict_helpers.py, tests/test_predict_loader.py, tests/test_predict_runner.py. No change in models/, runtime/, main.py, evaluation/, tests/test_cascade.py. API FOR FEAT-004: loader.load_model(path, branches, precision='checkpoint'|'float32', device='gpu'|'cpu') -> LoadedModel(level, model, frozen, model_cfg, knobs, step, prefix (abs), run_dir, config (full config.json dict), training_group_sizes {group_size, deform_group_size}, precision {requested, device, trainable 'mixed_float16'|'float32'|'float32 (cpu)', frozen 'float32', deform_decoder_dtype {checkpoint, used}}); knobs = {amp, split_group_conv, deform_decoder_dtype, fp16_act_clip, fp16_act_clip_scope, bn_epsilon_override, lowres_method (None if absent), lean_sampler {checkpoint, used: True}}; LoadedModel.stage_models() -> {level: model}, .levels (coarse -> fine). LoadedModel can be built directly from models in tests (knobs derived from the model). LoaderError(ValueError) for: bad path, no config.json ('no config.json next to the checkpoint'), bad/unknown branches, deform branch without decoder, build failure, restore failure, missing/mismatched cascade fingerprint (message names 'level-4' / 'level-2'), no step. loader.unchunked_n_max(level, cfg, tasks|branches, split, frozen_levels=None) -> int, loader.check_unchunked(n, ...) -> n_max or LoaderError 'unchunked mode at level 1 supports at most 4 subjects (largest tensor d1 skip concat, 440401920 elements per image); use --mode streamed or fewer --n-subjects' (frozen stage binding -> '<tensor> of the frozen level-K stage'). Device placement is the caller's (loader does no tf.device). runner.BRANCHES as specified; runner.branch_tasks(br) (ValueError naming the four values). StreamedRunner(loaded, store, chunks={'l1','l2','l4'} (defaults 2/8/32, 0=whole group), lean=True, record_fp16=True) and UnchunkedRunner(loaded, lean=True); both .run(images [N,160,224,192] or [...,1] float32 numpy, branches, sink=None) -> summary {mode, level, n, branches, A (numpy [N,4,4] or None), chunks {'l<lv>': {task: [(i0,i1),...]}} (P0 boundaries per level and task), chunk_sizes, capped {'l<lv>': StreamedLevel.capped}, stats {max_abs_v {'l<lv>': float}} (unchunked: checkpoint level only), fp16_max_abs {'l<lv>': {block: {max_abs, ratio}}} (streamed only; {} for float32), timing_s {'<task>:l<lv>' | '<task>:frozen' (unchunked) | 'pool' (unchunked) | 'affine+deform:resample': s} (unchunked stages synced with a 1-element .numpy()), gpu_peak_mb (same keys, MiB; None without a logical GPU)}. sink(i0, i1, res) res = {A [k,4,4] tensor | None, U1, U1_inv (level-1 voxels), u_ckpt, u_inv_ckpt (checkpoint level, after compose_cascade), v, v_raw (checkpoint-level residual)}; at level 1 U1 IS u_ckpt (same tensor). Sink chunks: deform branches = the checkpoint level's P12 chunks (StreamedLevel bounds, possibly capped); linear-only = chunks['l1'] bounds; unchunked = one call (0, N). affine+deform streamed: store 'src_affine' (full-res f32, all N) = CS.prewarp_linear(I, A, 1 mm) per l1 chunk, freed after the last chunk of the checkpoint level's P0; A in res is the affine A (canonical composition is FEAT-004). Streamed level-2/4 prev fields: StreamedLevel stores 'L4_u'/'L4_u_inv'/'L2_u'/'L2_u_inv' freed after the next level; store empty after run (asserted). UnchunkedRunner: frozen part (stage.linear / chain.linear_stages['A'], stage.deform / chain.deform) and trainable part (prewarp + model + compose_linear / warp(lean) + model + compose_cascade(lean)) are separate tf.functions with input signatures keyed by n; check_unchunked first. DEVIATION: predict_helpers.save_level4_run returns (prefix, model) (the test compares restored weights with the saved model); save_cascade_run / save_chain_run return the prefix; default_args(level, amp, **kw) gives the config args (split_group_conv True, lean_sampler True, group_size 4, deform_group_size 2). GPU peaks (L2 TINY unchunked): resample ~1.3-1.5 GB, deform:l2 ~1.5 GB. tests.test_predict_streaming 16 tests OK (397 s, maxima unchanged from FEAT-002). tests.test_cascade 47 tests OK (3124 s). WARNING FOR FEAT-004 / FEAT-005 (host memory of the level-1 CPU tests): peak RSS is ~21 GB (a) and ~24.5 GB (b) at N 3, far above the design-10.1 estimate 6-9 GB; WSL here has 25.5 GB RAM + 7 GB swap. A probe (TINY_L1, N 3, CPU) attributes it to ONE unchunked level-1 deform tf.function call (maxrss 5.8 -> 14.4 GB; the graph executor runs independent ops of the integration / compose / sampler corners in parallel; the trainer's own validation forward is the same kind of call); models built 4.6 GB; streamed runs add little (~+1 GB). FEAT-004's level-1 file test should therefore not hold extra full-res arrays across modes, should reuse one trainer reference, and stay in its own test module/process; unittest runs modules in separate processes in run_tests_wsl.sh. tf.function retracing WARNINGs in the log are expected (many runners / engines per process).
